title: Ground-penetrating radar finds 50-ft reinforced concrete structure

He did a ground-penetrating radar check on the road around Bradshaw Ranch. And we found a 50-ft wide, reinforced steel concrete, highly visible on ground-penetrating radar, literally just under the ground.

as_told.title: Ground-penetrating radar finds 50-ft reinforced structure under Bradshaw Ranch road

plain: A hidden structure of steel-reinforced concrete, about 50 feet wide, lies beneath the road around Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona. That is what Ross Coulthart, a journalist who says he has found a UFO base in Arizona, tells Michels. He says that in 2025 a man named Paul scanned the road with ground-penetrating radar, which uses radio waves to see what lies below the surface, and the structure showed up clearly. In a later conversation he adds that it sat "literally just under the ground," which if true would mean something built and buried on purpose at a place he links to UFO activity.
